thread:
maria: Heads-up: I noticed staging proxy rolled a metrics contract change. python/go SDKs are losing metric namespaces. @alex any idea? :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: services/proxy v2.8.1 deployed to staging (maria triggered)
alex: Oh — saw py-client CI failing. Repro: set REDWOOD_METRICS_NAMESPACE env, sent request, got 400 'unknown namespace'.
sam: Is this the header rename from `X-Redwood-Metrics` -> `X-RdMetrics`? That was in the PR.
maria: Yeah PR #4321 changed header key and flattened payload shape. Intended for telemetry normalization but sdks weren't updated.
tai: We should ship a shim in proxy that accepts both keys for a few weeks. Can we do header compat? @alex
alex: I can add parsing for old header quickly. But SDKs should patch too. Suggest: proxy shim + quick patch release for py/ts/go clients.
sam: Console dashboards rely on metric name prefixes too — need to map old->new prefixes in ingestion for 24–48h to avoid alert storms.
maria: Agreed. Steps: 1) proxy shim accepting both keys (low risk), 2) ingestion mapping aliasing old prefixes, 3) patch SDKs and publish minor releases. Who volunteers?
alex: I'll open patch branches for python and go tonight. Quick fallback snippet for py:
```python
ns = os.getenv('REDWOOD_METRICS_NAMESPACE') or headers.get('X-Redwood-Metrics') or headers.get('X-RdMetrics')
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created canary deployment for proxy shim to staging-canary
devex-bot: devex-bot: cc @devex for rollout UX docs — announce in SDK changelogs and console release notes
tai: I'll land the shim and add a feature flag `accept_legacy_metric_header` (default true) so we can flip after 30d.
sam: :thumbsup: Also add a warning log when old header seen so we can measure usage before turning flag off.
alex: Good call. I'll emit a telemetry event when SDKs send old header and include deprecation text in CHANGELOG.
maria: OK plan. Can we sync quickly at 16:00 today if needed? If anyone sees regressions ping #incidents.
alex: :raised_hands: I'll coordinate releases. ETA: py patch tomorrow morning, go + ts within 48h.
maria: Thanks all. Will update thread with PR links once opened.
